correctness.rationale: Exact 15,48,30 cell model meets the 2-particle graph subdivision criteria; connected 1-skeleton gives rank d1=14; a signed determinant -1 of a 26x26 d2 minor and four independent integral nullcycles imply rank d2=26. Full 48 automorphism actions on kernel and cellular chain traces prove both rational character identities, verified with packaged CHECKER.py and CERTIFICATE.json. Rational representations are determined by characters, and finite-group rational transfer yields quotient claims.

value.rationale: Full rational automorphism representation of a natural 6-vertex Platonic graph configuration space resolves symmetry information not inferable from Betti numbers, for a group of 48 elements. It detects a genuine topological distinction between full and rotational quotients (no positive rational homology versus a first-degree invariant line), and provides a fully reproducible exact benchmark for graph-braid group symmetry, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
